event.title: Chinese Neuroscientist Detained by ICE After Airport Incident
event.canonical_title: Chinese Neuroscientist Detained by ICE After Airport Incident
event.summary: A Chinese neuroscientist affiliated with Princeton University has been detained by US Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) following an incident at a Washington airport. The dean of Princeton's graduate school expressed concern over the situation, highlighting the distress it has caused within the university community.

timeline.title: Chinese Neuroscientist Detained by ICE After Airport Incident
timeline.summary: A Chinese neuroscientist at Princeton University has been detained by Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) following her arrest at a Washington, D.C. airport. The Department of Homeland Security claims she overstayed her visa and lacked authorization to study in the US Her lawyer has indicated that she has a pending asylum application.
key_facts: Chinese neuroscientist at Princeton detained by ICE
Detention occurred at a Washington, D.C. airport
Department of Homeland Security claims visa overstay
Pending asylum application reported by her lawyer
sources: AP - Top News via Google News
